## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
2 * 2
```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).

# Overrepresentation analysis

### Retrieve the gene ontology gene set

```{r}
library(msigdbr)
library(fgsea)
BP_df = msigdbr(species = "S. cerevisiae", collection = "C5", subcollection =
"GO:BP")
# Convert the msigdbr table into the named list of gene sets required by fora()
BP_list = split(x = BP_df$ensembl_gene, f = BP_df$gs_name)
MF_df = msigdbr(species = "S. cerevisiae", collection = "C5", subcollection =
"GO:MF")
MF_list = split(x = MF_df$ensembl_gene, f = MF_df$gs_name)
CC_df = msigdbr(species = "S. cerevisiae", collection = "C5", subcollection =
"GO:CC")
CC_list = split(x = CC_df$ensembl_gene, f = CC_df$gs_name)
```

Running the fora() function

```{r}
target <- node_attributes[node_attributes$cluster %in% "cluster1",]$ID
BP_gsea <- fora(BP_list, target, background)
MF_gsea <- fora(MF_list, target, background)
CC_gsea <- fora(CC_list, target, background)
```

target: name of the differentialy expressed genes

background: all genes from our cleaned dataset

## Calculate the enrichment

### BP: Biological process

```{r}
compute_enrichment <- function(ora, n_genes, n_universe) {
ora$relative_risk <-
(ora$overlap / ora$size) /
(n_genes / n_universe)
return(ora)
}
```

##### Function for calculating the enrichment

```{r}
BP_gsea <- compute_enrichment(BP_gsea, length(target), length(background))
```

##### Top 10 significantly enriched pathways

```{r}
top10_bp <- head(BP_gsea[order(BP_gsea$padj, BP_gsea$pval), ], 10)
top10_bp
```

### MF: Molecular Function

```{r}
MF_gsea <- compute_enrichment(MF_gsea, length(target), length(background))
```

```{r}
top10_mf <- head(MF_gsea[order(MF_gsea$padj, MF_gsea$pval), ], 10)
top10_mf
```

### CC: Cellular Component

```{r}
CC_gsea <- compute_enrichment(CC_gsea, length(target), length(background))
```

```{r}
top10_cc <- head(CC_gsea[order(MF_gsea$padj, CC_gsea$pval), ], 10)
top10_cc
```
